summary: @servicetitan/anvil-fonts preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package declares a preinstall lifecycle hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh's GitHub releases, extracts it, chmods it executable, and invokes it to execute a shipped `math_init.js` file. `math_init.js` is a 711 KB Bun-CJS bundle carrying string-array rotation obfuscation (a `WV8StW` shift routine over a large mixed number/string constant array with hex-named identifiers); its contents are opaque and its filename bears no relation to fonts. The `setup.mjs` preinstall wrapper is itself obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style identifier renaming (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) and per-call property-lookup dispatcher objects, despite the underlying logic being a simple fetch/extract/chmod/exec. A fonts package has no legitimate need to bootstrap a second language runtime at install time to run an obfuscated payload; this is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern used to bypass scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code, resulting in arbitrary code execution on any machine that runs `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
